tasks.title: Durable append-only events and artifacts
acceptance: Interrupted writes and corrupt records never invent completed samples; hashes are checked.

evidence.review: pass (round 2)
evidence.note: Independent review round 1 returned FAIL with 13 defects, all real: a credential echoed as a JSON key was never redacted; a complete final record whose newline was lost was dropped while a single-record store reported clean; invalid UTF-8 was silently replaced with U+FFFD inside valid-looking records; payload_hash was checked only for self-consistency so an event could be repointed at another artifact; identical payloads collided on a content-derived event_id and collapsed in the index; attempt_id and manifest_hash bypassed CSV redaction and formula defusing; the index published two contradictory accepted-sample counts; replay never bound a payload's campaign to its event; an unresolved attempt was silently dropped by replay (its test was vacuous); the recorded evidence claimed a mutation that did not reproduce; the process-interruption test never interrupted anything; ingest silently dropped rows on a shorter re-ingest; and events_skipped miscounted. All are fixed with dedicated regression tests, each re-verified by re-introducing the mutation. The false mutation claim is now recorded honestly as failures_observed: 0.
